title: Redmine 6.1.0 before 6.1.6 and 7.0.0 before 7.0.3 OAuth Scope Bypass in Project Creation (CVE-2026-133115)
description: Redmine versions 6.1.0 before 6.1.6 and 7.0.0 before 7.0.3 have an authorization vulnerability in OAuth token scope enforcement during project creation. OAuth clients with only project-creation scope can improperly set project visibility and membership inheritance, potentially making projects public and granting unintended access to subprojects.
